# Under --output-datastar TemplateData gains DatastarRequest, true when the
# request carries "Datastar-Request: true" (every Datastar @get/@post/...
# action sends it). A plain GET route can branch on it: a fragment for an
# action, the full page for a direct visit, with Vary so caches keep both.
# Without the flag the method does not exist, and an SSE route's data
# does not have it either.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
! muxt check
stderr 'DatastarRequest not found on TemplateData'

muxt generate --output-datastar --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

cp sse-template template.gohtml
muxt generate --output-datastar --use-receiver-type=Server
! muxt check
stderr 'DatastarRequest not found on SSETemplateData'

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /list List(ctx)" -}}
{{- with .Header "Vary" "Datastar-Request" -}}
{{- if .DatastarRequest -}}
{{- template "list" .Result -}}
{{- else -}}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><body>{{ template "list" .Result }}</body></html>
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "list" -}}
<ul id="list">{{ range . }}<li>{{ . }}</li>{{ end }}</ul>
{{- end -}}
-- sse-template --
{{- define "GET /stream sse(Stream(ctx, execute))" -}}
{{- if .DatastarRequest -}}<li>{{ .Result }}</li>{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) List(context.Context) []string { return []string{"one", "two"} }

func (Server) Stream(_ context.Context, send func(string) error) { _ = send("one") }
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	for _, tt := range []struct {
		name     string
		header   string
		wantPage bool
	}{
		{name: "direct visit", wantPage: true},
		{name: "datastar action", header: "true", wantPage: false},
	} {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/list", nil)
			if tt.header != "" {
				req.Header.Set("Datastar-Request", tt.header)
			}
			rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

			if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
				t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
			}
			if got := rec.Header().Get("Vary"); got != "Datastar-Request" {
				t.Errorf("Vary = %q, want Datastar-Request", got)
			}
			body := rec.Body.String()
			if !strings.Contains(body, `<ul id="list"><li>one</li><li>two</li></ul>`) {
				t.Errorf("body = %q, want the list fragment", body)
			}
			if got := strings.Contains(body, "<!DOCTYPE html>"); got != tt.wantPage {
				t.Errorf("full page = %t, want %t; body = %q", got, tt.wantPage, body)
			}
		})
	}
}
